note: Flags do not block the merge (per owner instruction). Each flag lists its evidence source IDs (see sources.json) and the manual action needed.

flags.item: The three submitted identifiers are not 10-character ASINs
flags.detail: The identifiers in the submitted links are B04G1MEwY, B02NbDxp3 and B00hJ57DV. Each is 9 characters long. The official Creators API documentation shows ASIN examples of 10 characters (S06), and all three redirect targets use 10-character IDs (S14-S16). Typing amazon.com/dp/<each ID> returns 'Page Not Found' (S08-S10). No product name, brand, price, rating or commission can be tied to these identifiers.
flags.action: Provide the intended product page URL or 10-character ASIN for each product (the owner's input is needed; this session cannot infer it).

flags.item: Short links redirect to three different products, not confirmed as the submitted products
flags.detail: Each short link ended on a different amazon.com product page (S11-S13), and the mapping was the same on two fetches each. The final URLs carry the parameters lv=shuf and plpRedirect=mhFallback. The page titles identify two CHEFMAN air fryers and one Emeril Lagasse air fryer toaster oven (S14-S16). What these parameters mean is not documented in any official source reviewed, so they are recorded as observed only and never used as product data.
flags.action: Open each submitted link in a normal browser and confirm where it lands. Confirm which product was intended.

flags.item: link.amazon links are not documented in the Associates policies reviewed and may be Redirecting Links
flags.detail: The Program Policies reviewed (S02) do not name link.amazon. The policies prohibit a link shortener that makes the Amazon destination unclear (PF-06, section 6(w)). They also disqualify purchases referred by a Redirecting Link, meaning a link that sends users through an intermediate site without a customer click (PF-07). The short links redirected automatically to amazon.com in the fetch tool (S11-S13). A third-party competitor claims link.amazon forwards to amzlinks.in (S17). That claim is not verified against any Amazon page.
flags.action: Test each link while logged in to an Associates account and record whether tracked clicks appear. Generate Special Links from Associates Central instead, if the owner wants to use them.

flags.item: Product name, brand, price, rating, review count, competitor count, best-seller rank and availability are unverified for all 3 products
flags.detail: The identifiers do not resolve (FLG-001), so no official product record exists to read these values from. The fetch tool returned only the page title and the URL for the redirect targets (S14-S16); prices and ratings were not in its text. These cells are left blank on purpose.
flags.action: After FLG-001 is fixed, read the values from the Creators API (see FLG-006) or the live product page, then add them to data/products.json with a source ID.

flags.item: Commission rates are unverified; the official rate schedule is not accessible
flags.detail: The Commission Schedule link in the Program Policies (S03) redirected to an Amazon sign-in page on 2026-11-13. No rate was read, so no commission rate, commission-income estimate or payout figure is stated on this site.
flags.action: Sign in to Associates Central and export the rate card for the product category; send the file or the values so they can be added with a source.

flags.item: Automated product, price and review data needs Creators API access, which needs qualifying sales
flags.detail: The Creators API prerequisites require enrolment and 'at least 10 qualifying sales within the past 30 days' (PF-16, S04). Price and availability may be shown only if the link serves them or they come from the API (PF-04). Reviews and star ratings may be shown only through the API (PF-05). Pulling this data from amazon.com pages instead would not meet these rules, so it was not done.
flags.action: Confirm Associates enrolment status. Once eligible, register for the Creators API (S04) and provide credentials through a secure secret store, never in the repo.

flags.item: Another session's COORDINATION.md says PA-API 5 is the only sanctioned data source; the official notice says it is deprecated
flags.detail: Branch arena/3c6cba43-zone3 (read-only, not edited) states that PA-API 5 is 'the only sanctioned data source'. The official PA-API 5 deprecation notice says it 'has been deprecated and is being replaced by the Creators API' (PF-17, S05). This site uses the Creators API as the data source.
flags.action: Integration session: correct the statement on the other branch before merging it.

flags.item: Three other session branches claim the same tasks; merging them will conflict
flags.detail: Read-only observation of origin branches arena/26634cd5-zone3, arena/3c6cba43-zone3 and arena/a9cafea1-zone3. Each has its own COORDINATION.md and task claims, and the same files as this branch (site pages, data, COORDINATION.md). This session did not edit or push to them.
flags.action: Integration session: reconcile the task boards, keep one data source, and re-run scripts/check_site.py after each merge.

flags.item: Repository baseline was a single README; no license and no .gitignore
flags.detail: Before this session, main contained one commit (ed1a796 'Initial commit') with one file, README.md, whose contents were '# Zone3' (7 bytes). No license, data, code or COORDINATION.md existed.
flags.action: Owner: choose and add a license if the repo is to be reused. Not added in this session because the licence choice is the owner's.

flags.item: No Associates tag was supplied; no Special Links were created
flags.detail: Every Special Link must carry the Associates tag (PF-03, S02, section 2(b)). Without the owner's tag, no link on this site is a tracked Special Link. The submitted links carry only srctok and channelId parameters (S11-S13).
flags.action: Supply the Associates tag (not a password or token) so Special Links can be built and tested.

flags.item: No click or conversion data exists; the campaigns ledger is empty on purpose
flags.detail: Click and conversion figures come only from the owner's Associates reports, which need a logged-in account. Tracking rules are recorded (PF-12, PF-13). No click or conversion value has been invented.
flags.action: Export the Associates reports for the tag once Special Links are live, then add them with source references.

flags.item: No SEO articles, comparisons or buying guides were written
flags.detail: Content would need verified product facts (PF-10 forbids inaccurate or misleading product claims) and first-hand experience that has not happened (PF-21). Writing copy from the redirect titles would present unconfirmed products as the submitted ones. The content section records what is blocked and why.
flags.action: After FLG-001 and FLG-004 are resolved, the content pipeline can generate drafts from verified data for owner review.

flags.item: Disclosure is in the footer; placement needs owner review
flags.detail: The required statement (PF-01) is on every page. The FTC asks that a disclosure be hard to miss and placed with the endorsement (PF-20). The footer may not meet that standard for a product recommendation. Account enrolment could not be checked from this session.
flags.action: Owner: review the placement and confirm the Associates account is active.

flags.item: Source pages show different copyright years
flags.detail: The Associates Operating Agreement and Program Policies show a footer of '© 1996-2025'. The Amazon product pages show '© 1996-2026'. Both were read on 2026-11-13. The header dates (S01: October 15, 2025; S02: April 14, 2026) were used as the versions read.
flags.action: None required. Re-check the policy version before each content update.
